title: STATE ToxiCN: A Benchmark for Span-level Target-Aware Toxicity Extraction in Chinese Hate Speech Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of span-level toxicity extraction and identifying hateful slang in Chinese. While it defines hate speech as encompassing attacks based on religion, its primary focus and evaluation categories are social demographics like gender, race, and sexual orientation, rather than an evaluation of faith, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical systems.
